text:
**Studienstiftung** is a German scholarship organization founded in 1925 as a department of the Deutsche Studentenschaft. It was dissolved under National Socialism in 1934 and re-established in 1948 in Cologne. The Studienstiftung offers financial and academic support to undergraduate and graduate students in Germany, other EU countries, and Switzerland, with no citizenship or age requirements.
Scholarship holders are selected through various channels, including school nominations, professor nominations, examination board nominations, and self-nomination via an assessment test. The program provides a monthly allowance of €300, need-based scholarships (up to €855/month), and additional support for students with children. Scholars also benefit from academic programs such as summer academies, language courses, and mentoring.
The Studienstiftung offers a doctoral scholarship for highly qualified and prosocial PhD students. It has a long history of supporting outstanding students, with notable alumni including Nobel laureates and prominent figures in science, business, and politics. The organization continues to operate with a strong focus on academic excellence, initiative, and social responsibility.
